# Pull request

## Summary

- Scope (player / installer / docs / CI):
- Automated evidence (`typecheck`, `npm test`, native and package gates as applicable):

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, backups, captures, or private paths committed
- [ ] No unrelated changes; Windows-only impact considered
- [ ] Diagnostics sanitized; confirmations default to "no"
- [ ] No stable→beta migration, no downgrades, no package-manager mixing
- [ ] Physical QA (if claimed) performed by the developer, not the agent
